Instructions: Create an IAM Role for your EC2 instance to access S3

Step1_CreateRole.description: Create IAM Role with EC2 trust policy

Step2_AttachPolicy.description: Create and attach S3 access policy

Step3_CreateInstanceProfile.description: Create instance profile and add role

Step4_AttachToEC2.description: Attach the instance profile to your EC2 instance
Step4_AttachToEC2.note: Go to EC2 Console > Select Instance > Actions > Security > Modify IAM Role
